description: Source-reviewed PresetBundle workflow mutants retained by the reviewed PresetBundleWorkflowsExtended cases. Outcomes are omitted until isolated mutation runs.

mutants.description: Ignore include_modify for the process export; selected-versus-edited roundtrip should detect the stale value.
Change the export filter from system-or-default to system-and-default; the selected user profile set should expose the altered eligibility rule.
Invert JSON printer type dispatch; a valid print import should no longer be assigned to the printer collection.
Invert the import path confinement guard; the scoped JSON import contract should reject an escaping preset name.
Break the no/skip overwrite decision; re-importing with a rejecting callback should preserve the existing file.
Invert subscribed bundle pruning; an empty update must remove the prior canonical preset while retaining unrelated profiles.
Invert local bundle discovery; a scoped local metadata directory should still load its canonical bundle preset.
